title: Letting LLMs Choose Their Own Context: Questions, Approaches, and Open Problems
description: An exploratory, non-peer-reviewed discussion note (in Chinese and English). It asks whether letting a model, or a dedicated decision model such as Jev, choose which context to assemble on each turn improves accuracy; how this differs from agent memory mechanisms; why it may sharpen focus even at the same context length; several implementation routes; the problems they face (notably prefix-cache invalidation and silent constraint violations); and mitigation ideas and open problems. 中文标题：让大模型自己挑选上下文：一份探索性笔记。
